name: REVEREND SOWERBY
note: Reverend Sowerby (doc 01: 'presides over funerals with enormous feeling... Charges by the adjective'). In Room 4 he presides over the Assay: errata 75 -- 'The judges sit in the dark beyond the lamp; Sowerby holds the pencil' -- and reads the handbill's five rules before each duel (doc 03). His drawing is room-04's fifth operation (Tyler, 2026-11-01: the fourth had a chair in front of his leg, which no cut could recover): the room edited to flat magenta around him and Thad, with him redrawn whole, keyed by tools/art/room04-sowerby.py. He stands at the foot of the back wall in the judges' shadow, between the front chair and the table's left end, at the room's curve (437 at his soles, y 513: the annotation's `beyond` sample). Present while the Assay sits (errata 76 B). His id is his speaker id, so his lines are drawn over his head. No tree in this room; every verb is doc 07's people pool.
walkToNote: On the floor in front of him, at the band's back edge, facing him.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Sowerby in Room 4.

sprite.note: Frames: 0 rest · 1 breath · 2 pencil hand lowered · 3 lowered further · 4 raised · 5 leaning toward the judges · 6 leaning back, all derived from his rest frame by tools/rig/room04-idles.py (the forearm turned about the elbow). Breathing on 0 and 1 at `rate`; every `breakEvery` seconds one break from the pool -- most of them the pencil marking the air (errata 35: deliberate movement; Tyler, 2026-11-01: 'Sowerby's arm needs to move up and down otherwise it looks like he's frozen').

props.note: THE JUDGES' PENCIL, IN HIS HAND. The plate paints the pencil on the table for the room without him; while he is present he holds it (errata 75), and this piece of the plate's own bare table -- the wood beside the pencil, matched row by row -- covers the one on the table. Drawn only while he is, because a prop is his.
